# Host your event with us. Our cinema, your way.

From corporate events to kids' parties and private screenings, Everyman's venues are yours to hire. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll help make it happen.

[Find my Everyman](#find-venue)

![Private Hire at Everyman](https://ww2.everymancinema.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimage.mux.com%2F5eAUu93A3hhkroW4K3aLYvclP9b008lc5%2Fthumbnail.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

## Nothing left to chance.

## What's included in every hire.

- Pick the content
  
  The latest release, a firm favourite or your own content, all on the big screen
- The screen's all yours
  
  No strangers, no shushing, your event your way
- Room to relax
  
  Let your guests sink into the comfort of our signature luxury sofas
- Food & drinks sorted
  
  Pre order your food and drink from our extensive private event menus.
- A helping hand
  
  A dedicated host to organise the perfect event

## We have the perfect space for every event.

### Corporate Event

Forget the boardroom tech that never quite works. Plug your laptop into our big screens and present like you mean it. With state-of-the-art tech and a venue team who'll make sure you properly wow the room.

### Kids Birthday Party

Ready to delight the kids and their friends? Our kids' party packages have you covered. Choose a private screening of the latest blockbuster, or a nostalgic family favourite from our extensive catalogue, all on the big screen.

### Private Screening

Celebrate your landmark birthday, or just get your friends together to watch your favourite cult classic with a signature cocktail. We've got you covered.

### School Booking

Looking for a treat for your pupils, or a film to bring the curriculum to life? We've got special weekday rates available for school bookings.

### Launch Event

Looking to partner with us to host an event: a Q&A, press event, product launch, influencer event, or film festival? Get in touch, we'd love to chat.

### Charity Events

We work with a selection of charities each year, contact us to discuss your proposal.

### Weddings at Screen on the Green, Islington

Say "I do" in one of the UK's oldest cinemas, and walk down the same aisle as the Sex Pistols and The Clash.

## About Everyman Kings Cross

Everyman Kings Cross is a **Trusted Tagvenue Partner**, validated by the Tagvenue team with a record of successful bookings on the platform.

We are redefining cinema, with state-of-the-art venues offering a truly unique experience combining luxurious seating, great bars and in-chair waiter service. We have the very best technical facilities, with each of our cinemas available for hire 7 days a week, so whether you’re seeking the perfect space for an intimate private screening or a red carpet extravaganza, our dedicated and experienced private hire team will ensure your event is delivered seamlessly.

If you’re looking for something a little different to delight the kids, we’ve got the perfect range of party packages to suit any age range or group size. Treat them to a private screening of the latest blockbuster release, or surprise them by showing an old favourite from our extensive catalogue on the big screen.

Each venue is individually available for private hire - perfect for everything from corporate and client events to celebrations. Featuring our signature comfortable sofas, plenty of leg room and bespoke design features, each of our screens provide a unique event space sure to impress your guests.

There is something for everyone at Everyman!
